A material holds single values, tables against temperature where they may vary, and models (plasticity, Johnson–Cook, ...). The material builder says which properties a study still lacks, per solver.

## General

<!-- key: property:density -->
### Density

`density`, in kg/m^3; may vary with temperature.

## Structural

<!-- key: property:youngs_modulus -->
### Young's modulus

`youngs_modulus`, in Pa; may vary with temperature.

<!-- key: property:poissons_ratio -->
### Poisson's ratio

`poissons_ratio`, in dimensionless; may vary with temperature.

<!-- key: property:yield_strength -->
### Yield strength

`yield_strength`, in Pa; may vary with temperature.

0.2 % offset; the curve builder and fatigue corrections use it

<!-- key: property:tensile_strength -->
### Tensile (ultimate) strength

`tensile_strength`, in Pa; may vary with temperature.

Engineering ultimate; the curve builder and fatigue use it

<!-- key: property:welded_tensile_strength -->
### Welded tensile strength

`welded_tensile_strength`, in Pa; may vary with temperature.

F_tuw, an aluminium's ultimate in the weld-affected zone (ADM Table A.3.3)

<!-- key: property:compressive_yield_strength -->
### Compressive yield strength

`compressive_yield_strength`, in Pa; may vary with temperature.

F_cy, the Aluminum Design Manual's (Table A.3.4); unset: the yield strength

<!-- key: property:proof_strength -->
### Proof strength

`proof_strength`, in Pa; may vary with temperature.

A fastener's proof stress (ISO 898-1, SAE J429, ASTM); preloads and checks use it

<!-- key: property:thermal_expansion -->
### Thermal expansion coefficient

`thermal_expansion`, in 1/K; may vary with temperature.

Secant (mean) coefficient from the reference temperature

## Thermal

<!-- key: property:thermal_conductivity -->
### Thermal conductivity

`thermal_conductivity`, in W/(m*K); may vary with temperature.

<!-- key: property:specific_heat -->
### Specific heat

`specific_heat`, in J/(kg*K); may vary with temperature.

## Fluid

<!-- key: property:dynamic_viscosity -->
### Dynamic viscosity

`dynamic_viscosity`, in Pa*s; may vary with temperature.

## Electromagnetic

<!-- key: property:relative_permittivity -->
### Relative permittivity

`relative_permittivity`, in dimensionless; may vary with temperature.

<!-- key: property:relative_permeability -->
### Relative permeability

`relative_permeability`, in dimensionless; may vary with temperature.

<!-- key: property:electrical_conductivity -->
### Electrical conductivity

`electrical_conductivity`, in S/m; may vary with temperature.

<!-- key: model -->

`plasticity`

<!-- key: model:johnson_cook -->
### Johnson–Cook plasticity (strain rate)

`johnson_cook`

<!-- key: model:failure -->
### Failure and erosion (Johnson–Cook)

`failure`

<!-- key: model:orthotropic_elasticity -->
### Orthotropic elasticity

`orthotropic_elasticity`

<!-- key: model:hyperelasticity -->
### Hyperelasticity

`hyperelasticity`

<!-- key: model:anisotropic_conductivity -->
### Anisotropic thermal conductivity

`anisotropic_conductivity`
